name: Cesar Oviedo
headline: Senior Director - Head of Professional Services for Latin America
position: Senior Director Professional Services - LATAM Lead
about:
A business unit leader managing an international territory focused on SaaS implementations, contract negotiation and client engagement. Full P&L oversight; manages and develops operational budget and business strategy. Diverse clients in Retail, CPG, Pharmaceuticals, Fashion, E-commerce.

25+ years of experience leading Software Solutions implementations and consulting teams for Manhattan Associates, Microsoft, SAP and Oracle in Latin America. Proficient in account management and program management, positioning and leading SaaS complex implementation of SCM, ERP and CRM cloud-based solutions.

Skilled at building implantation roadmaps to align project delivery with client requirements as well as with corporate revenue, profitability, and customer satisfaction goals. Experience as a Portfolio Director and Program Director managing a team of project managers, architects and consultants. Track record of strategic recruiting and coaching staff to build high performance teams that exceed corporate goals. 

Languages: English and Spanish.

experiences.position: Senior Director Professional Services - LATAM Lead
experiences.description:
- Head of Latam profesional services organization. 
- Focused on Manhattan Active cloud-based solutions implementations (SaaS).
- Latin America P&L responsibility. 
- Performs on-going risk analysis and provides support of sales activities.  
- Develops and mentors line managers and team members.

• Managed the consulting and support business units for Peru.
• Defined and executed operation budget: $10M+ in annual revenues.
• Exceeded sales quota, revenue and profitability targets during 2012, 2013 and 2014.
• Developed a trusted advisor relationship with key customers, selling and delivering on-premises and cloud-based Microsoft solutions (CRM, ERP, Office 365, BI, Social, Mobility, Security & Websites), maximizing adoption.
• Exceeded customer satisfaction index targets during 2012, 2013 and 2014.
• Hired and led 20+ staff, overachieving team satisfaction index targets during 2012, 2013 and 2014.
• Partnered with business partners, growing at an average rate of 24% year over year.

• Managed the Northern Latin America Consulting Operation: Central America, Ecuador, Colombia, Venezuela and the English and Spanish Caribbean Islands. 
• Defined and executed operation budget: $30M+ in annual revenues.
• Best results ever in the region during fiscal year 2010, overachieving consulting sales quota (+25%), revenue (+20%) and profitability (+19%).
• Led 100+ staff regional and off-shore team to sell and implement Solutions Applications (ERP, SCM, CRM, HCM) and Technology (SOA/BPM, BI, Performance Management, Enterprise Architecture, Security & Portal). 
• Account management of the region’s most important customers.
• Increased partner ecosystem to improve and expand sales coverage and delivery capacity.

• Oversaw portfolio planning, deployment approach of Oracle Solutions in Central America and the English and Spanish Caribbean Islands.
• Managed portfolio projects and $15M budget.
• Experience as a Delivery Director managing a team of local, regional and remote project managers, architects and consultants, +40 employees.
• Generated value with creative approaches to solution delivery by defining implementation roadmaps for diverse portfolio of over 30 projects.
• Achieved a high customer satisfaction index by providing outstanding customer service and a win-win negotiation approach in every customer engagement.

• Led SAP Consulting for Puerto Rico and the English and Spanish Caribbean Islands.
• Defined and executed operation budget: $10M+ in annual revenues.
• Led local and global delivery off-shore team, 30+ employees.
• Managed key accounts, positioning, selling and overseeing profitable implementation projects (ERP, CRM, BI, HCM, Portals) for Financial institutions, Telecommunications, Retail, Oil&Gas, Utilities and Government entities.
• Achieved intended results on time, carefully managing scope, assessing risks, implementing mitigation, recovery plans and negotiating change requests.
• Developed partner ecosystem to expand sales coverage and delivery capacity.

• Led SAP Consulting and SAP Education for Peru, responsible for strategy, planning, execution, P&L, selling and delivering SAP solutions. 
• Led and managed a local team of 15 professionals.
• Project Manager and certified consultant for Financial/Controlling (FICO) modules.

• Managed project lifecycle of J.D. Edwards ERP Software implementation in Chile and Peru for Manufacturing, CPG and Pharmaceuticals companies. 
• Subject matter expert on Financials, Sales and Logistics modules.
• Responsible for analyzing, designing and developing expert systems in Chile (C++).
